routing.task_class: AVS MCP agent-operated video timeline planning, editing, validation, preview, and export
natural_language_triggers: 無音カット計画をAVSに渡して
他プラグインの編集計画を適用して
routing.primary_route: Use Agent Video Studio MCP tools and avs.auto-edit-plan.v1 for structured agent-to-agent editing.
fallback_conditions: Use CodexVideo or another owning plugin for STT, TTS, visual generation, or provider-backed media generation before AVS import.
non_use_conditions: Do not use AVS for publishing, authentication, generic one-off ffmpeg repair, or hidden provider calls.

trigger_phrases: 動画を手動編集できる形に

inputs.name: MCP project and media references
inputs.description: Stable AVS project, revision, track, media, and clip IDs obtained from current MCP read/import tools.

inputs.name: External analysis or inline edit plan
inputs.description: Stable-ID silence ranges or a strict avs.auto-edit-plan.v1 produced by the host agent (Codex or Claude Code) or another plugin.

outputs.name: Inspected auto-edit plan
outputs.description: Canonical SHA-256 plan hash, projected operation results, before/after timeline inspection, and validation.

outputs.name: Atomic AVS session mutation
outputs.description: One committed project-session revision and undo unit with structured per-operation outputs.

user_facing_ui.display_verification: crates/avs-app/selftest/run.sh <script> (drives the built editor against an isolated library and saves screenshots) and the App Shell Foundation check

rules.description: Agent-authored edits use a strict versioned schema, stable producer/target/operation IDs, and sequential timestamp semantics.
Plan application requires exact project revision, inspected plan hash, explicit confirmation, valid projected timeline, and one session revision.
The host agent (Codex or Claude Code) and other plugins can discover plan, inspect, and apply routes through aligned plugin, skill, and MCP metadata.
The existing AVS UI exposes Japanese, English, and System language choices plus Light, Dark, and System theme choices with persistence.
